_comment: Golden fixtures: symbolic command intents (PLAN-metalstorm-command-language.md §8). `expected` is what a correct model emits for `utterance` on board `context`; `expect` is what the EXECUTOR must then do with it. Every reference is a NAME — no ids, no coordinates the context didn't supply.
_verbs: The verb vocabulary is compile-table.ts's eleven, and it has no `move`. 'Move 2 tank squads to Randtown' (a plan §0 example utterance) maps to `secure` — take and hold — which is what a macro-layer 'move there' means and what the compile table already turns into a Defend directive. The LLM prompt (M4) teaches this mapping; these fixtures pin it.

fixtures.name: named squad, named region
class-count fans out into one directive per squad
fixtures.note: The acceptance case. Candidates are the three tank groups; idle-first drops busy Basilisk behind, then nearest-to-Randtown picks Chimera (900,1100) over Warhound (2800,2800). Two sends, in that order.

fixtures.name: class-count with an explicit ms_scale
fixtures.utterance: two heavy tank squads secure Slag Forge
fixtures.note: scale 3 excludes Warhound (scale 2), leaving Chimera (idle) then Basilisk (busy) — a busy squad is still a valid candidate, just a worse-ranked one.

expected.say: Two heavy tank squads are securing Slag Forge.

fixtures.name: the scale can ride in the class phrase instead
fixtures.utterance: send two heavy tanks to Fallow Gate
fixtures.note: `class: 'heavy tanks'` and `class: 'tanks', scale: 3` must resolve to the same squads — the vocabulary's scale phrases are alternative spellings, not a second mechanism.

fixtures.name: nearest-to-target unavailable falls through to largest-first
fixtures.note: No group centroids on the wire today. Both squads are idle and equidistant-by-default, so the largest goes first — a missing tie-break degrades the ORDER, never the candidate set.

fixtures.name: unqualified order with nothing selected is team-wide
unqualified order with a selection uses the selection
hold with no group compiles to a standing order
fixtures.note: compile-table's defend/hold branch: a real group id gets a GroupDirective, groupId 0 gets a StandingOrder. The envelope doesn't choose — the compile table does.

fixtures.name: a platoon is as orderable as a squad
scout
escort a landmark
fixtures.utterance: Chimera Squad, escort the grain silo

fixtures.name: defend the grain silo — a landmark, from landmark_* rulesParams
fixtures.note: The plan's own example utterance (§ worldbuilding). Nothing publishes landmark_* yet — the scenario-gen lane owns that — so the fixture world synthesizes the rulesParams and runs them through the REAL parseLandmarksFromRulesParams (fixture-world.ts). This fixture is therefore evidence about the WIRE SHAPE, not about a hand-built entity: the day a publisher lands, the resolver already finds what it emits. No subject named and nothing selected ⇒ the team-wide standing order, same as any unqualified order.

fixtures.name: withdraw takes only a point, so a named place becomes one
fixtures.utterance: pull Chimera Squad back to Randtown
fixtures.note: `withdraw` accepts shape 'point' alone (TARGET_SHAPES_BY_VERB). The resolver keeps the entity attached and picks the point shape, rather than refusing an order the compile table can express.

fixtures.name: reinforce with no group is a standing order
build
fixtures.utterance: Warhound Squad, build at Sector B9

fixtures.name: an idle-class subject says so out loud
fixtures.note: Neither GroupDirectivePayload nor StandingOrderPayload has a slot for filterClass, so this reaches the sim as 'any force'. The echo must admit it — implying a filter that isn't applied is the exact dishonesty this lane keeps closing.

saysLike: the idle-class filter has no wire slot yet

fixtures.name: when: under attack
fixtures.utterance: Chimera Squad defend Northgate when under attack

fixtures.name: when: a region is contested, named not id'd
fixtures.utterance: Chimera Squad attack Slag Forge if Northgate is contested
fixtures.note: `regionRef` is the display name 'Northgate'; the compiled phase gate carries the KEY 'north_gate_ridge'. The two differ in every fixture context on purpose.

fixtures.name: when: strength below a threshold
fixtures.utterance: Chimera Squad pull back to Randtown if it drops below 40 percent

fixtures.name: area-around a place
names match case-insensitively
fixtures.note: Exact-match is case-insensitive on BOTH halves, and an exact match short-circuits the fuzzy tier — so a lowercase sentence never becomes an ambiguity question.

fixtures.name: an order to the AI reaches the guidance store
fixtures.note: subject 'ai' compiles to AIGuidance (compile-table checks it first, before verb:shape). integration.ts used to warn and drop this; guidance-wire.ts now maps it to a guidance.paint on the region.
